normalization.canonical_form: lowercase ASCII; each segment uses lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; exactly three non-empty segments separated by two colons
normalization.whitespace: rejected; no trimming or case folding

scopes.description: Submit an effect for G09 authorization-admission evaluation; does not authorize execution.
Execute an effect only after independent authorization and all runtime safety gates pass.
Issue a governance approval within the issuer's independently verified authority.
Revoke an approval within the issuer's independently verified authority.
Read a memory record after independent identity, tenant, classification, and policy checks.
Write a memory record after independent identity, tenant, classification, and policy checks.
Retrieve from an authorized knowledge source after source-level permission checks.
Request credential verification; does not itself establish identity or grant capabilities.

governance_constraints: A registered scope identifier is a vocabulary reference, not an authorization grant.
G02 must establish the authority and scope of a signed approval from trusted evidence.
G09 must independently verify issuer authority, signature, policy version, validity interval, revocation, and replay protection before admitting an effect.
Capability declarations and principal identity do not grant authorization.
Unknown identifiers, malformed identifiers, aliases, wildcards, whitespace, and unsupported representations fail closed.
No permission inheritance or escalation is implied by domain, resource, or action relationships.
This registry defines identifiers only; it does not define runtime policy, credential trust roots, issuer enrollment, or execution semantics.
